description: This file declares the ConfiguredProxyResolutionService class, which manages proxy resolution including PAC file evaluation, proxy configuration fetching, and network change handling within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionService
classes.description: Manages proxy resolution, including PAC script evaluation, configuration fetching, and network change responses.

classes.name: PacPollPolicy
classes.description: Defines policies for polling PAC scripts for updates, including timer-based or activity-based polling modes.

methods.name: ResolveProxy
methods.description: Resolves the proxy for a given URL using fallback strategies.

methods.name: MarkProxiesAsBadUntil
methods.description: Marks specified proxies as bad until a certain time.

methods.name: SetPacFileFetchers
methods.description: Sets dependencies for PAC file fetching.

methods.name: GetPacFileFetcher
methods.description: Returns the current PAC file fetcher.

methods.name: SetProxyDelegate
methods.description: Sets a delegate for proxy events.

methods.name: ForceReloadProxyConfig
methods.description: Forces re-fetching and applying the proxy configuration.

methods.name: GetProxyNetLogValues
methods.description: Returns log values related to proxy resolution.

methods.name: CreateUsingSystemProxyResolver
methods.description: Creates an instance using system libraries for PAC evaluation.

methods.name: CreateWithoutProxyResolver
methods.description: Creates an instance without PAC support.

methods.name: CreateFixedForTest
methods.description: Creates a proxy service with fixed settings for testing.

methods.name: CreateFixedFromPacResultForTest
methods.description: Creates a fixed proxy fallback list for testing.

methods.name: CreateFixedFromAutoDetectedPacResultForTest
methods.description: Creates a fixed auto-detected PAC result for testing.

methods.name: set_stall_proxy_auto_config_delay
methods.description: Sets delay for stalling proxy auto-config, used in tests.

methods.name: set_pac_script_poll_policy
methods.description: Sets the PAC script polling policy, used in tests.

methods.name: CreateDefaultPacPollPolicy
methods.description: Creates the default PAC polling policy.
